item.title: "היה לי בבית גבר יפה כמו פרח. ב'הבימה' כולם היו עם גיבנת, לא היה על מי להסתכל"

item.title: Missiles from Iran, Lebanon hit Israel, 12 impact sites reported, 4 lightly wounded
item.description: Emergency teams scan 12 locations after strikes across central and northern Israel; four lightly wounded in Bnei Brak, including two infants, with additional cases of shock reported

item.title: Missile barrages ahead of holiday: girl fighting for her life, teen seriously injured
item.description: Cluster missile from Iran hits multiple central Israel sites, critically wounding 11-year-old girl and seriously injuring teen in Bnei Brak; damage reported in Tel Aviv, launches also target north and south as IDF strikes Tehran and Beirut

item.title: Israel spotted Radwan buildup before Hezbollah strike, weighed preemptive attack
item.description: Security officials say Israel detected about 1,000 Radwan Force operatives mobilizing in southern Lebanon before Hezbollah’s opening retaliation to Iran war, prompting discussions of possible preemptive strike

item.title: קלוד תחת אש: טראמפ רוצה לזרוק, אבל הצבא חייב אותו
item.description: אחרי שהקריס את המניות של ענקיות הטק והציב איום על פרנסתם של המתכנתים, מודל ה–AI "קלוד" מחולל מהפכה גם במלחמה עם איראן ועוזר לצבא האמריקאי לשפר את הביצועים. אנת'רופיק, המפתחת שלו, מתעקשת להגדיר קווים מוסריים לשימוש בו ומוציאה את טראמפ מהכלים

item.title: Iran missile fire sets off sirens in Haifa area and the Galilee; no casualties reported so far
item.description: Sirens warning of missile fire were activated in the valleys, Carmel and throughout the Galilee

item.title: 'The fire isn't random': Iran’s retaliation strategy shows command and control still intact
item.description: Tehran is no longer just mirroring attacks on its own soil; it is expanding its response by targeting parallel sectors — from energy and nuclear sites to industry and academia — while signaling it is ready to raise the cost across the region

item.title: Sirens wail across central and southern Israel as Hezbollah resumes fire
item.description: Alerts stretch from Tel Aviv to Ashdod and Ashkelon; two rockets explode in open areas, no injuries; earlier barrages from Iran and Lebanon set off nonstop sirens across center, causing minor damage

item.title: Six-story building collapses in Tel Aviv; one injured, four apartments damaged
item.description: Officials said the incident is not related to the war with Iran, and the cause of the collapse remains under investigation

item.title: Hezbollah launches dozens of rockets, drones at northern Israel
item.description: Repeated barrages trigger alerts from Haifa to the Galilee; drones spotted and intercepted as emergency teams report no immediate casualties
